# cloudraya_vpc_network (Data Source)

Looks up an existing CloudRaya VPC subnet by name, across every VPC in the project. To create a subnet instead, use the `cloudraya_vpc_network` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Finds an existing subnet by name across every VPC in the project.
data "cloudraya_vpc_network" "existing" {
  name = "app-subnet"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Subnet name, for example `app-subnet`.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project to query under. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Subnet identifier (ULID), usable as a `network_id`.
- `network_address` (String) Resolved CIDR, for example `10.20.0.0/24`.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC the subnet belongs to.
